Glance 2026.10.11 improves preview navigation, text search and add-on information.

## 更新内容

- 为纯文本、Markdown 源码和 JSON 结构化视图增加查找，支持区分大小写、全词、正则表达式及 JSON 键名／值筛选，并区分搜索匹配与当前字段高亮。
- 多文件侧栏支持调整宽度和折叠，新列表默认展开。
- 画廊使用半透明悬浮前后按钮，在底部显示项目进度和文件名；来源支持时提供可点击、拖动的进度条。
- 附加组件与来源统一通过信息按钮显示本地化资料，副标题显示对应标识，状态详情显示在状态图标的悬浮提示中。
- 通用预览高级信息采用完整展开的分块布局，减少信息陆续出现时的布局变化，并恢复基本信息的上下居中。
- 音视频滚轮定位根据总时长调整步进，范围为 1 至 5 秒。
- 改善亮色主题下的按钮悬浮对比度，特别是关闭亚克力时的显示效果，并统一设置页退出图标。
- 改善退出时的预览资源释放，过滤过期播放状态，移除多余的定位时间提示。
- 修复全景预览启动时先显示黑色窗口的问题，移除多余加载图层。

## Changes

- Search plain text, Markdown source and structured JSON with case, whole-word, regular-expression and JSON key/value filters; distinguish matches from the current field highlight.
- Resize or collapse the multi-file sidebar; new lists open expanded.
- Navigate galleries with translucent floating buttons, bottom item progress and filenames, plus a clickable and draggable progress bar when the source supports it.
- View localized component and source information from a shared information button; show their identifiers as subtitles and status details on status-icon tooltips.
- Keep generic preview details in fully expanded sections, reduce layout changes as information arrives and restore vertical centering of basic information.
- Scale audio and video wheel seeking to the total duration, with steps from one to five seconds.
- Improve light-theme hover contrast, particularly with acrylic disabled, and use the standard settings exit icon.
- Release preview resources on exit, ignore stale playback updates and remove redundant seek-time tooltips.
- Prevent the initial black window in panorama previews and remove the redundant loading overlay.
